rules.name: _build
rules.what: Compiled code for this Mix project and its dependencies.
rules.comeback: Mix compiles it again the next time you run mix compile, mix test or iex -S mix.

rules.name: deps
rules.what: Source code of this project's Hex and Git dependencies, as pinned in mix.lock.
rules.comeback: mix deps.get downloads them again at the versions in mix.lock.

rules.name: .stack-work
rules.what: Stack's work folder for this project: build artefacts and project-local installs.
rules.comeback: stack build creates it again. stack clean --full is Stack's own way to remove it.

rules.name: dist-newstyle
rules.what: Cabal's build folder for this project: compiled modules, binaries and caches.
rules.comeback: cabal build creates it again. cabal clean removes it the same way.

rules.name: .zig-cache and zig-out
rules.what: Zig's build cache and the installed build output for this project.
rules.comeback: zig build creates both again. The first build afterwards is just slower.

rules.name: target
rules.what: sbt's generated files for this project: compiled classes, packaged jars, caches and docs.
rules.comeback: sbt compiles everything again on the next build.

rules.name: .cpcache
rules.what: The Clojure CLI's cache of computed classpaths, to start faster.
rules.comeback: Computed again the next time you run clj or clojure in this project.
